project.name: fintech-banking-core-payment-gateway
project.description: Payment gateway ledger backend (Spring Boot 4) with Next.js admin portal

tasks.title: Spring profile config: H2 dev profile with console, datasource and JPA settings
tasks.notes: application.properties is bare; add dev/prod profiles, H2 console, open-in-view off, SQL logging in dev

tasks.title: REST API: merchants CRUD endpoints with validation and error handling
tasks.notes: POST/GET /api/merchants, DTOs, RestControllerAdvice error format per system-design.md

tasks.title: REST API: payments and transaction ledger endpoints
tasks.notes: POST/GET /api/payments, POST /api/payments/{id}/transactions, idempotency by idempotencyKey, 409 on illegal transitions

tasks.title: API-key auth filter for merchant endpoints (X-API-Key)
tasks.notes: Static per-merchant key lookup; 401 without key, 403 for wrong merchant scope; admin endpoints exempt for MVP

tasks.title: Admin portal: connect to backend API (merchants and payments views)
tasks.notes: Replace default Next.js page with data views backed by /api; typecheck and lint gates

tasks.title: API integration tests and benchmark baseline
tasks.notes: MockMvc/WebTestClient integration tests for all endpoints; record baseline latency into benchmarks/results/

tasks.title: Add pagination to list endpoints (merchants, payments)
tasks.notes: Envelope {content,page,size,totalElements,totalPages}; size 1..100; fixed createdAt DESC; type-mismatch handler; portal unwraps; 31 tests

tasks.title: Support FEE transactions in ledger API
tasks.notes: FEE accepted in AUTHORIZED/CAPTURED/REFUNDED, capped at payment amount, status-neutral, excluded from captured total; 35 tests

tasks.title: Admin portal authentication: passphrase sign-in, signed session cookie, guarded staff views
tasks.notes: PORTAL_PASSCODE shared passphrase; HMAC-signed 12h cookie ledger_session; (staff) route-group gate; /login + logout POST; fails closed; stateless across restart; walkthrough evidenced

tasks.title: Concurrent load benchmark: find where p99 breaks the 200ms target
tasks.notes: Load harness 5 scenarios x 6 levels; writes break 200ms p99 between 16-64 workers (Hikari pool queueing), list at 64, detail+mixed survive to 256; load-2026-09-17.{md,json}

tasks.title: Merchant lifecycle endpoints: suspend, reactivate, close with domain transition rules
tasks.notes: Transitions in Merchant entity; 3 endpoints; setStatus package-private; CLOSED terminal 409; filter lockout proven E2E; portal contextual actions; NoResourceFoundException now 404; 44 tests

tasks.title: Admin portal pagination controls using the TASK-07 envelope totals
tasks.notes: Server-rendered prev/next over ?page=N; totals indicator; status filter composes; guards: bad param -> 0, out-of-range -> truthful indicator + one-click recovery; walkthrough verified with seeded data

tasks.title: Fee aggregation endpoint (totals per merchant and overall)
tasks.notes: JPQL sum(group by merchant,currency) + per-currency totals; /api/fees; exact decimal strings; 45 tests

tasks.title: Scoped merchant auth: merchant keys read only their own data; internal key for ops
tasks.notes: Merchant keys forced to own data (list forced, detail 404 cross-merchant); INTERNAL_API_KEY internal tier; /api/fees internal-only; 49 tests

tasks.title: CSV export of payments (GET /api/payments/export)
tasks.notes: GET /api/payments/export text/csv; 500-row chunks; RFC4180 escaping; scoped like list; 52 tests

tasks.title: Merchant self-service dashboard (served by backend) + finance fees view in admin portal
Merchant portal: standalone Next.js app consuming the gateway API with API-key auth
